text: In the leaky-integrator ESN, setting the leak rate alpha = 1 recovers the vanilla ESN update with no explicit leak.
explanation: With alpha = 1 the update (1-alpha)x_t + alpha*tanh(...) reduces to x_{t+1} = tanh(W_rec x_t + W_in u_{t+1} + b), the original vanilla ESN with no leaking term. The statement is true.
